assessment: PP0024 narratively summarizes oil preparations for functional dyspepsia. Its cinnamon source used a filtered cinnamon-bark infusion in sesame oil in soft capsules and measured gastrointestinal symptoms. Original Table 2 reports week-six total gastrointestinal score P=.174 between arms. Neither source tests ground cinnamon or daytime sleepiness.
